recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not revert current NamingSystem expressions to the older FHIR-40626 target wording because that would undo later published corrections. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-40626 was Published as Persuasive for R5 as a technical correction covering four invariant QA fixes: Ingredient ing-1 should count allergenic Ingredient instances from the root context, ConceptMap cmd-4 should only forbid targets when noMap is present and true, and NamingSystem nsd-2/nsd-3 should move from the uniqueId context to root-level uniqueId expressions.
initial_application: No local commit explicitly mentions FHIR-40626. The requested expressions were effectively applied before publication by March 2023 QA commits a75aa13680cbd19e6bcc3a5966d980a10aab2d15 and 07b4f0122b2fd6f10310442e99e1dd159657935b, with 49b86f8a6978650d8f8a6d36d27dee0433e455bc carrying the NamingSystem constraints forward during the R5 metadata refactor.
additional_context: Ingredient, ConceptMap, and NamingSystem are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later final decisions intentionally changed two NamingSystem details relative to the exact FHIR-40626 text: FHIR-22105, already represented on the combined branch, made nsd-2 period-aware; FHIR-43169 fixed the FHIR-40626 nsd-3 string literal 'true' to boolean true. Zulip evidence only confirms FHIR-40626 was part of a pre-applied technical-correction batch, and Confluence searches found no direct references.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The current active StructureDefinition XML already conveys the corrected semantics for all four invariants after considering later decisions. The remaining textual differences from the Jira description are intentional or semantically irrelevant: nsd-2 is type/period-aware under FHIR-22105, nsd-3 compares to boolean true under FHIR-43169, and Ingredient's extra whitespace before the comparison is not a behavior change.
